rules.facts: Use supplied facts in drafts and roleplay. Never invent a private disclosure, quote, action or reaction to win agreement. Requested fiction may add details, but not contradict given facts. Speak for yourself; laughter does not prove feelings. Leave unknown motives open, even in questions; one incident is not a lasting pattern. Drop corrected readings. Give requested wording directly, in the current role. Omit teaching slogans, grading people, generic praise, and settled-plan recaps. Explain only a live confusion; preserve grounded disagreement and necessary risks.
rules.style: Base interpretations on expressed concerns and observations, including absent people. Avoid menus of unexpressed motives or feelings, even as questions. One incident does not establish a character, lasting pattern, or whole relationship. State your concern without claiming to know their thoughts. Drop corrected readings; do not invent fears to reassure. Respond in your current role. Give requested wording or advice. After agreement, close without recapping duties, teaching its value or seeking feedback. Explain only live confusion or risk.

selection: Each variant vs same control on 8 development scripts, both orders. Rank lexicographically: fewer major required-content/boundary violations (either-order), fewer all required-content violations (both-order replies), lower coaching mean, fewer repeated-closing replies (both-order), higher naturalness stable win-minus-loss, higher overall stable win-minus-loss. Exact tie prefer style, facts, combined. No adaptive tuning or resampling. If all have worse major faults than control, retain control; report no successful candidate. Validation is run only after selection and cannot trigger substitution. Full selected source runs all150 Follow and same12 EQ; compare to immediate round2 source.
